exposure: Timing and type of sterilization procedure (interval vs. postpartum)
Parity at last delivery (1-2 children vs. 3+ children)
cohort: 1673 women (975 women living with HIV and 1,003 women not living with HIV) aged 18 to 49 in São Paulo, Brazil
finding: While there was no overall difference in sterilization rates between women living with HIV and those not, women living with HIV had lower access to interval sterilization and higher likelihood of postpartum sterilization, particularly in conjunction with cesarean section.
mod_finding: Women living with HIV had a higher likelihood of undergoing postpartum sterilization, particularly when performed in conjunction with a cesarean section.
